title: Mushroom Swiss Steak Pan
seoTitle: Mushroom Swiss Steak Pan | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Seared round steak with mushrooms and Swiss over mashed potatoes for ten
subtitle: Seared round steak with mushrooms and Swiss over mashed potatoes for ten
description: Sirloin strips sear fast, simmer with mushrooms and onions in a rich broth base, then finish off heat with sour cream for a silky sauce. Serve over wide egg noodles with parsley.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.instruction: Pat sirloin strips dry and season with salt and pepper. Sear in butter over high heat in batches 30–45 seconds per side until browned but still pink inside. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook mushrooms and onion
steps.instruction: In the same pot, sauté mushrooms and onion 8 minutes until moisture evaporates and edges brown. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.instruction: Pour in beef broth and simmer 5 minutes, scraping fond from the bottom. Whisk Dijon into sour cream, then stir off heat into the warm broth until smooth.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.instruction: Boil egg noodles in salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and toss with a tablespoon of butter.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.instruction: Return beef and any juices to sauce and warm 2 minutes—do not boil. Serve noodles topped with stroganoff and parsley at the line.

proTips: Partially freeze sirloin 20 minutes for easier thin slicing.
If sauce breaks, whisk in a spoonful of cold sour cream off heat to bring it back.
Frozen peas stirred in at the end add color and stretch the dish cheaply.
tonightSpread: Stroganoff over noodles with crusty bread for sauce mopping.
Simple cucumber salad with dill for a cool contrast.
leftovers: Reheat gently with splash of broth—microwave on medium, not full blast.
Fill baked potato skins with stroganoff and melted cheese.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Stroganoff is pure comfort after cold calls. The sauce feels indulgent but comes together in one pot plus a noodle boil—manageable even for newer cooks.
mealPrepNotes: Slice beef against the grain thin for tender bites. Stir sour cream off heat so it does not break. Hold sauce and noodles separately if holding more than 30 minutes.
